# Website packages and pricing

Website projects are quoted after a free consultation. Do not provide fixed or starting package prices. Invite the visitor to call, use WhatsApp or request a free quote. The written proposal confirms scope, price, responsibilities and exclusions.

## Foundation

**Quoted for your project**

A focused custom website for a business establishing or replacing a basic online presence.

- **Up to 3 pages:** Usually Home, About and Contact, adjusted to the agreed scope.
- **Custom design:** A visual system and page layouts shaped around the business.
- **Mobile-responsive build:** Designed and tested for common phone, tablet and desktop sizes.
- **Contact form and WhatsApp link:** Clear ways for visitors to contact your business.
- **SEO (Search Engine Optimisation):** Page-level metadata, internal structure, crawlable pages, sitemap setup and technical search foundations; rankings are not guaranteed.
- **30 days of post-launch support:** Bug fixes and minor agreed adjustments during the support window.
- **1 revision round:** One defined round of consolidated feedback.

## Starter

**Quoted for your project**

A larger custom website for a growing business with more services or content.

- **Up to 5–6 pages:** Suitable for service pages, galleries and more detailed business information.
- **Custom design:** A visual system and page layouts shaped around the business.
- **Mobile-responsive build:** Designed and tested for common phone, tablet and desktop sizes.
- **Contact form and WhatsApp link:** Clear ways for visitors to contact your business.
- **Google Analytics setup:** Basic visitor measurement when the required account access and consent setup are available.
- **SEO (Search Engine Optimisation):** Page-level metadata, internal structure, crawlable pages, sitemap setup and technical search foundations; rankings are not guaranteed.
- **45 days of post-launch support:** Bug fixes and minor agreed adjustments during the support window.
- **2 revision rounds:** Two defined rounds of consolidated feedback.
- **Content management:** A configured editing interface for agreed text and image fields.

## Growth

**Quoted for your project**

A more extensive website for businesses with deeper content, service lines or integrations.

- **Up to 10–12 pages:** A broader site structure for multiple services, audiences or content areas.
- **Custom design:** A visual system and page layouts shaped around the business.
- **Mobile-responsive build:** Designed and tested for common phone, tablet and desktop sizes.
- **Contact form and WhatsApp link:** Clear ways for visitors to contact your business.
- **Google Analytics and Google Business Profile setup:** Basic visitor measurement plus Google Business Profile setup or configuration support when the required account access, consent setup and verified business details are available.
- **SEO (Search Engine Optimisation):** Page-level metadata, internal structure, crawlable pages, sitemap setup and technical search foundations; rankings are not guaranteed.
- **60 days of post-launch support:** Bug fixes and minor agreed adjustments during the support window.
- **2 revision rounds:** Two defined rounds of consolidated feedback.
- **Content management:** A configured editing interface for agreed text and image fields.

## Custom

**Scoped per project**

For projects whose page count, functionality or integration needs do not fit a standard package.

- **A written scope:** Deliverables, responsibilities, assumptions and exclusions agreed before work begins.
- **Direct communication:** Work directly with the person responsible for the build.
- **A project-specific plan:** Architecture, milestones and timeline based on the agreed requirements.
- **Relevant integrations:** Functionality and third-party services agreed in the project scope.
- **Post-launch support:** The support period and coverage are defined in the proposal.
- **Content management when required:** Editing tools can be included where they fit the project requirements.

## Payment terms

- Foundation and Starter: 50% deposit to start, 50% before launch
- Growth: 40% deposit, 40% at design approval, 20% on launch
- Custom: confirmed in the project proposal

## Optional add-ons

- **Additional page:** Quoted for the additional pages
- **Page content writing support:** Quoted for your content needs
- **Custom booking or enquiry form:** Quoted for the agreed form
- **Google Business Profile setup:** Quoted after an initial discussion
- **Rush delivery:** Quoted separately, subject to availability
- **Content management for Foundation:** Quoted for Foundation; included in Starter and Growth

Search rankings, traffic, enquiries, bookings and revenue are not guaranteed.
